description: Golden query set for the MotoBuddy assistant. Each case asserts the agent GROUNDS its answer by firing the expected tool(s). `expectTools` = tools that must fire; `expectRefusal` = the assistant must decline/deflect instead of inventing data. Edit freely as the catalog and behavior evolve.

cases.message: I'm looking for a helmet for city riding
show me riding gloves under 1500 rupees
something to keep my bike gear dry in the rain
find me a black jacket, then tell me if the first result is in stock in size L
roughly how much does a good motorcycle chain cost at your store?
cases.note: Must not invent a price — should search and quote real ₹ figures.
No phone/email supplied -> tool refuses -> assistant must ask for identity, not fabricate a status.

cases.message: will your tail tidy fit a Royal Enfield Classic 350?
cases.note: Must hedge: text hint only, advise confirming fitment.

cases.message: can I return order 656f1a2b3c4d5e6f77889900, my phone is 9999999999
tell me a joke about cats
cases.note: No tools; brief reply then steer back to shopping.

cases.message: do you sell snow tyres for a jet ski?
cases.note: Search will return weak/no matches -> assistant should say it couldn't find it, not invent one.
